comment: Model price id -> item name in prices.json. Explicit on purpose: an unmapped id or a null price fails loud. Where a choice exists it favours Elasticsearch: Elastic Serverless uses Logs Essentials (its cheapest logs SKU); S3 uses the first-50-TB rate for every GB (higher than the volume tiers, which overstates Cartridge and Elasticsearch-frozen S3 alike).
